senses.sense_definition: The formal procedure of granting recognition or equivalence to a degree from a foreign university.

examples.text: She submitted all her official transcripts to complete the <w>nostrification</w> of her medical diploma.
The university requires diploma <w>nostrification</w> before foreign applicants can be hired as professors.

senses.sense_definition: The transfer or expropriation of foreign-owned capital, property, or business shares to domestic owners.

examples.text: The new government enacted economic laws mandating the <w>nostrification</w> of foreign industrial enterprises.
Historians analyzed the postwar <w>nostrification</w> of foreign companies throughout Central Europe.
